tagline: The intelligent menstrual & cycle tracker where your body data stays strictly yours.
elevatorPitch: CycleCipher is the world’s first truly private, Zero-Knowledge menstrual and symptom tracker. It gives women pinpoint cycle and ovulation predictions while mathematically sealing their intimate health data on their device with military-grade AES-256 encryption. No ads, no data selling, and no predatory monthly subscriptions.
keyFeatures: 100% Zero-Knowledge Privacy: Sealed locally on iPhone (Secure Enclave) with military-grade AES-256 encryption. Nobody can access it — not even the developers.
Zero Ads & Zero Tracking: No third-party ad networks, no Meta/Google trackers, no data brokers. Ever.
Pinpoint Cycle & Ovulation Forecasting: Real-time biological phase tracking (Menstrual, Follicular, Ovulatory, Luteal) & adaptive statistical modeling that filters out irregular outlier cycles.
Smart Body Pattern Recognition: On-device correlation engine linking cramps, mood swings, headaches, bloating, and energy levels.
2-Second Quick Symptom & Mood Logging: Frictionless logging of flow intensity, physical symptoms, emotions, and intimacy notes.
Discreet Mode & Biometric Lock: Face ID / Touch ID lock + neutral disguised lock-screen notifications.
Clinically Referenced: Grounded in verified clinical guidelines from ACOG, NHS UK, and Mayo Clinic.
No Subscription Trap: 30-Day Full-Access Free Trial, then a single €9.99 / $8.99 Lifetime Access purchase (instead of $40-$60/year subscriptions).
